title: Sahabat Nyang Meuputa .
intro: Kamoe karab meubuka kisah sidroe jiwa nyang udeb lam bayangan kenabian teuma geupiléh jalan nyang meuarah u kehancuran. Tokoh nyoe meubagi rumoh ngon salah sidroe rasul nyang geupiléh lé Allah tapi gagal lam ujian iman. Soe rakan nyang ka gadoh nyoe?
clues: Ulôn udeb lamkawan ureuëng-ureuëng nyang jitulak panggilan keu keubeunaran, dan ulôn hana lôn lawan awaknyan.
Lon meukawen ngon sidroe nabi Allah, tapi hana lon bagi keyakinan.
Watée utosan-utosan nyan teuka u rumoh ulôn deungon peuingat, ulôn hana lôn peucaya.
Pasangan lon geuyue tinggai banda nyan meusajan ngon ureueng-ureueng meuiman, dan lon hana lamkawan awaknyan.
Huköman nyan jitron u ateueh umat Ulôn, dan Ulôn pih binasa meusajan-sajan ngon awaknyan.
Lon na geu seubot lam Al-Quran seubagoe contoh kafir, di samping peurumoh Nuh, lam Surat At-Tahrim.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Dikhianati lakoe jih deungon hana meuiman .
Geuseumah patông deungon teubuka lam Ka'bah .
Hana geutem teurimong keunabian aneuk gobnyan .
trial.answer: Dikhianati lakoe jih deungon hana meuiman .

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
